messages:
jordyn: Quick sync 1: onboarding confusion again. sample-apps show three different auth conventions: `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, `RW_TOKEN`, and `REDWOOD_TOKEN`. Customers expect a single canonical env var.
kevin: Agreed. Also folks expect to scope keys to org/project so they don't accidentally use a key with too many permissions in a microservice. Right now we only enforce scope server-side.
tara: We should pick a canonical env var and a simple project/org override. Proposal: `REDWOOD_API_KEY` (canonical) + optional `REDWOOD_ORG` and `REDWOOD_PROJECT`. If project is set it will prefer that scope when exchanging for short-lived tokens.
jordyn: sounds good. For CI/CD, we need a documented pattern for short-lived tokens: CI uses a service account key (long-lived) to call our token endpoint to mint ephemeral tokens scoped to a single deploy. That way rotation is automatic.
kevin: Important SDK behavior: precedence order should be explicit constructor arg > env var > profile file (~/.redwood/config) > credential provider chain (GCP/AWS). Document it clearly.
tara: SDK authors: please add support for hot-reload from a file path. Common pattern: apps mount secret as file (k8s). If SDK watches a file and emits a `tokenChanged` event, apps can gracefully drain. Example in node: `new Redwood({ tokenFile: '/var/run/secrets/redwood/token' })`.
cli-bot: note: rw-cli already supports `rw auth login --profile prod` which writes profile to ~/.redwood/config. Consider improving format to include org/project.
jordyn: telemetry: if SDK sees the legacy `RW_TOKEN` env var, emit an anonymized metric so we can track migration. Don't log the key.
kevin: rotation UX: SDKs should try current token, and if 401 + header `X-Redwood-Key-Expired: true` present, automatically attempt local token refresh via a `tokenProvider` hook before failing requests.
tara: token shape: backend will return tokens with metadata: `kid`, `org`, `project`, `expires_at`. We should push SDKs to expose `client.keyInfo()` that surfaces `expires_at` so apps can show warnings. infra-bot: deploy-schedule: auth-service will include token metadata in standard responses on 2025-02-01.
jordyn: migration plan: 1) standardize env vars and docs (this week). 2) add aliases in SDKs that read old names + warn for 9 months. 3) publish migration guide & sample CI config (k8s, github actions).\e
kevin: sample k8s snippet for CI-minted ephemeral token:
```bash
# job step
curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.internal/v1/issue -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_ACCOUNT" -d '{"scope":"project:search","ttl":300}' > /tmp/token
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat /tmp/token)
```
tara: also add lint rules in sample-apps that fail CI if they still use `RW_TOKEN`. We can add an ESLint plugin and a pre-commit hook.
jordyn: owners? I'll take sample-apps and docs. Kevin take node + go SDK changes. Tara take python + ruby and the migration checklist.\e
kevin: I'll open umbrella GH issue with per-sdk subtasks, + a deprecation telemetry ticket.
cli-bot: created issue: DEVEX-777 - "Unify auth env vars + rotation UX".
infra-bot: FYI: KMS team will add `kid` to key metadata on 2025-01-20 to help with targeted rotate.
tara: one more: add a snippet in README for local dev: `rw auth login --profile dev && export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(rw config get dev.token)`. That smooths onboarding.
jordyn: ok perfect. I'll post this summary and a short migration checklist in the dev docs. Meeting Wednesday 11am to finalize naming.
cli-bot: reminder set for Wed 11:00.
